exposure: ultrasound-guided methotrexate injection directly into the gestational sac
cohort: 9 patients aged between 33 and 42 years with Cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
finding: Local ultrasound-guided injection of methotrexate into the gestational sac was found to be a safe and effective treatment for Cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy in a study of 9 patients.
mod_finding: The study focuses on ectopic pregnancies within Cesarean section scars, a condition directly related to a previous cesarean section.
